# ExtractMint

> ExtractMint converts bank statements, receipts, invoices, scans, PDFs, DOCX files, spreadsheets, CSV, and plain text into clean Excel, CSV, DOCX, PDF, QBO, and review-pack exports.

Website: https://extractmint.vercel.app/

## Business Summary

ExtractMint is a web-based financial document extraction product for founders, operators, accountants, and bookkeepers who need statement tables and business documents converted into structured working files.

Primary service area: global web app, with current SEO pages focused on bank statement conversion, PDF statement conversion, scanned statement OCR, CIMB-style statements, Maybank-style statements, and Singapore bank statement workflows.

## What ExtractMint Does

- Converts bank statement PDFs into spreadsheet-friendly rows.
- Exports Excel XLSX, CSV, Google Docs-ready DOCX, PDF summaries, QuickBooks-ready QBO, review JSON, review-pack ZIP, and combined workbooks.
- Handles text PDFs, DOCX files, spreadsheets, CSV, plain text, receipts, invoices, and images.
- Uses browser-side parsing and OCR in the current static implementation.
- Preserves transaction fields such as date, description, reference, withdrawal, deposit, tax, amount, category, and balance where available.
- Adds balance validation, reconciliation sheets, source PDF side-by-side review, OCR cache controls, and an Ask ExtractMint agent for conversion questions.

## Primary Use Cases

- Bank statement to Excel conversion.
- PDF bank statement to CSV conversion.
- Accountant and bookkeeper statement review.
- Founder/operator monthly reconciliation.
- Receipt, invoice, and office document extraction.
- QuickBooks QBO export preparation.
- Review-pack handoff between operators and accountants.

## Differentiators

- Browser-side static workflow for privacy-sensitive testing.
- Balance-trail validation and reconciliation-oriented exports.
- Multiple output formats from the same extracted rows.
- OCR fallback for scanned statements and images.
- Optional local caches (OCR + PDF review index) can be persisted in the browser and cleared in-app.
- Review JSON import/export so a conversion can be resumed later.
- FreeLLMAPI-ready agent route for explaining validation issues and export choices.

## Important Product Notes

- Text-based PDFs are the strongest input.
- Scanned statements rely on OCR and should be reviewed before export.
- Financial extraction should be validated against opening and closing balances before accounting use.
- The current app is a static browser-side prototype that can grow into a SaaS with accounts, credits, batch jobs, API access, audit logs, and server OCR.
